In a low-breadth regime, internal distribution dominates leading sector performance, demanding defensive cash preservation, progressive exposure, and ruthless risk containment. Even high-ranking candidates must clear strict CANSLIM quarterly earnings acceleration benchmarks (C+A). analysis.analyst: SEPA (Minervini) + CANSLIM (O'Neil) + Stage Analysis (Weinstein) + Darvas Box Discipline

AARTIPHARM.technical: Constructive double-bottom base emerging above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Volume on trigger test expanded to 1.24x the 20-day average. Momentum is solid with daily RSI at 68 and MACD trending comfortably above zero.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exceptional operational momentum driven by volume expansion in xanthine and active pharma intermediate segments. Operating leverage delivered 117% net profit expansion alongside 46.8% sales growth. Balance sheet remains healthy with low gearing and ROCE exceeding 11%.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A daily close below the 929.48 swing support invalidates the double bottom; trigger an immediate stop to limit portfolio drawdown.

AARTISURF.technical: High-velocity SEPA breakout clearing prior 20-session resistance on massive 10.24x average volume. Price structure is stacked cleanly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, signaling dominant institutional demand and high relative strength.
AARTISURF.fundamental: Turnaround acceleration validated by Q2 PAT surging 672% to Rs 12.59 Cr and sales jumping 62.5% YoY. Working capital cycle contracted from 32 to 21 days, though historical ROE near 5.2% demands ongoing margin preservation.
AARTISURF.risk: Failure to hold the 561.76 breakout level negates stage momentum; execute Minervini-style stop to avoid severe capital erosion.

ABDL.technical: Fresh 52-week high breakout from a consolidation box, supported by 1.93x average volume and positive MACD. Moving averages reflect textbook Stage 2 alignment above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200.
ABDL.fundamental: Top-line expanded 6.8% YoY with modest EBITDA gains of 10%, falling well short of O'Neil CANSLIM double-digit hurdles. Net debt elevated at Rs 1,273 Cr with net debt to EBITDA at 2.2x.
ABDL.risk: Break beneath 712.03 invalidates the base breakout; cut position immediately as sluggish fundamental growth limits downside cushion.

AEROENTER.technical: Constructive base compression hovering within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot. Price holds firm above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 59, reflecting orderly digestion prior to potential breakout expansion.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Core operating earnings lack CANSLIM consistency. Prior-quarter net earnings were inflated by substantial non-operating other income, followed by a 92.9% sequential contraction in Q2 PBT, indicating erratic operational quality despite low balance sheet leverage.
AEROENTER.risk: A decisive break below 146.48 breaches EMA21 and base support; exit ruthlessly to protect trading capital.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Textbook double-bottom reversal structure testing neckline resistance above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Pronounced lower wick demonstrates strong institutional price rejection off lows, supported by bullish MACD divergence.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Institutional-grade healthcare leader clocking 87% EPS growth and 31.4% revenue expansion, fueled by 22% surgical procedure volume gains and network scaling across 324 centers. Low gearing and expanding operating leverage sustain high quality.
AGARWALEYE.risk: Slipping below 531.32 breaches the double-bottom pivot low; honor predetermined stop discipline immediately to manage risk.

ALICON.technical: Double-bottom base clearing swing resistance on 1.45x volume expansion. Price holds firmly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, with RSI at 68 evidencing robust relative strength momentum without being overextended.
ALICON.fundamental: Record Q2 consolidated total income up 50.4% YoY to Rs 652 Cr with consolidated PAT up 26.7% (standalone PAT surged 97%). Aluminum raw-material headwinds pinched EBITDA margins to 9.7%, but a Rs 1,000 Cr order win pipeline underpins growth.
ALICON.risk: Violation of 908.77 pivot floor cracks the consolidation structure; liquidate position immediately under strict loss-cutting discipline.
